title: Preview your media, then send together
summary: Images, videos and files now share the message entry box. Review them and send with your text using the regular Send button.

sections.heading: One composer, one Send
items: Attachment previews appear inside the entry box with a small X to remove them.
The regular Send button sends your text with the first attachment, across General Chat, DMs, reply threads and Pins discussions.
Image and video selections wait for you to review and send.

sections.heading: Video and loading feedback
items: Paste videos when your browser provides a video file, or use the video picker.
Upload progress, cancellation and retry remain available without a separate attachment Send button.
Pins media now show a small loading bar while opening.

sections.heading: Compact keyboard controls
items: Use the small down chevron near attachments, or swipe down on Send, to close the phone keyboard.
A delayed send completion respects your decision to close the keyboard.
Apple's keyboard toolbar remains controlled by iOS. Tap Restart Now to load this update.
